title: Nature Finds a Way
creative_focus: Nature in the built environment and visual storytelling
prompt: Show a relationship between nature and the built city.
questions: What is the relationship between nature and the city?
Does it feel peaceful, surprising, resilient, or humorous?
Would freezing or blurring the movement strengthen the story?

variation.text: Photograph it once with a fast shutter speed and once with a slower shutter speed.
Try one version with a soft background and one with more of the environment in focus.

review_prompt: Which photograph tells the strongest story about nature and the city?
review_extra: Ask participants to give their shortlisted photograph a possible title.
